q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We will email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. Let me know if you need anything else!

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month and includes unlimited notes and support for up to 3 devices. You can also save 20% with annual billing.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: Team is $8 per user per month, so for 5 people it would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The Free plan allows up to 100 notes and supports 1 device. Plus is $4/month for unlimited notes and 3 devices, and Team is $8/user/month with shared workspaces. Annual billing saves 20% on Plus and Team.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number to request a refund. You can reach them at support@example.com.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Unfortunately, as you purchased it three weeks ago, a refund is no longer possible. Please contact support with your order number if you have further questions.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app. However, Linux users can use the web app!

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later. Please note that Android 11 is not a supported platform. If you have further questions, I can open a support ticket for you.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web app needs a connection to work. However, the mobile and desktop apps work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore" to recover it. I hope this helps!

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: We support authenticator apps for two-factor authentication, but SMS is not supported. You can enable it in Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication. Please let me know if you have further questions.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The free plan allows for attachments up to 25 MB per file. Plus and Team plans have a 250 MB per file limit. I hope this helps!

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep paid features until the end of the current billing period. You can cancel your plan in Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your data is stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit. Please let me know if you have any other questions about Example Notes.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: You can email support@example.com and we will reply within one business day. I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any other questions about Example Notes.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20% on Plus and Team plans. You can find more information about the plans in the FAQ.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use Example Notes on up to 3 devices. It costs $4 per month and also includes unlimited notes. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know. Please contact support@example.com and they will be happy to assist you.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know. Please contact support@example.com to open a support ticket.

answer: I don’t know. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

answer: I don’t know. There is no Linux desktop app currently, but the web app is available for Linux users. If you’d like to request a feature, you can contact support at support@example.com.
